definitions.gloss: sales position; sales job; sales role
definitions.explanation: A job category focused on selling products or services to customers or clients. One of the most common job types in Japanese companies.

examples.japanese: {営業職|えいぎょうしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧。

{営業職|えいぎょうしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: Sales jobs are suited for people who like talking to others.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配属|はいぞく}→配属：06159_haizoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{営業職|えいぎょうしょく}だった。
examples.english: The first position I was assigned to after graduating from university was in sales.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧ (sales/business) + ⟦{職|しょく}→職：00376_shoku⟧ (occupation). One of the most common job categories in Japanese companies, involving client visits, sales calls, and relationship building.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {営業職|えいぎょうしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧: to take a sales position
- {営業職|えいぎょうしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配属|はいぞく}→配属：06159_haizoku⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be assigned to sales
- {営業職|えいぎょうしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: sales experience

RELATED JOB CATEGORIES:
- ⟦{事務職|じむしょく}→事務職：17384_jimushoku⟧: office/clerical work
- {技術職|ぎじゅつしょく}: technical/engineering position
- {企画職|きかくしょく}: planning position
- {総合職|そうごうしょく}: management-track position

In Japanese job hunting (⟦{就活|しゅうかつ}→就活：05832_shuukatsu⟧), {営業職|えいぎょうしょく} is one of the most heavily recruited positions, especially for new graduates.
